page_title: WOL 1-1 AST | Wolves v Aston Villa 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+14' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!
90+13' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

90+13' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out for a corner. Aston Villa can continue in their attacking effort.
90+13' The corner is swung in but Aston Villa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+12' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Jose Sa. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.

90+10' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
90+10' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

90+9' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+7' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jose Sa intercepts the ball.
90+5' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target.
90+4' RED CARD! Mario Lemina (Wolves) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Robert Jones. He can have an early bath.

90+2' What a miss! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
90' 12 additional min. will be played.
89' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
86' That's the end of the game for Hee-Chan Hwang, who is replaced by Fabio Silva (Wolves).
84' Mario Lemina (Wolves) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom right corner and forces a good save out of Emiliano Martinez.
84' Sasa Kalajdzic (Wolves) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
82' Unai Emery has decided to substitute Boubacar Kamara and he is replaced by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) replaces Matty Cash.

81' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
78' Pedro Neto (Wolves) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
76' Here is a change. Matheus Cunha is going off and Gary O'Neil gives the last tactical orders to Sasa Kalajdzic (Wolves).

73' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Emiliano Martinez guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
69' Here comes a substitution. Joao Gomes is given a rest as he is replaced by Boubacar Traore (Wolves).
67' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
66' Referee Robert Jones seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and no action will be taken against Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa).

65' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa), but referee Robert Jones must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
63' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
62' Substitution. Moussa Diaby leaves the pitch and is replaced by Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa).
62' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Mario Lemina (Wolves) is given a yellow card.
60' Robert Jones blows his whistle and it's Matt Doherty (Wolves) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
59' It looks like Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) saw red with that tackle. Robert Jones won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
55' 1 - 1 A wonderful cross found Pau Torres (Aston Villa) in the box who shows good control of the ball and sends it inside the right post.
53' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Pedro Neto tees up Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) inside the box and he slams the ball past Emiliano Martinez.
52' Aston Villa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

52' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Aston Villa.
51' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
49' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
48' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

47' Jose Sa pulls off a great save to deny Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! The referee points to the corner flag and Aston Villa will take a corner.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Gary O'Neil gives a chance to Matt Doherty and Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) is off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
45' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) will take a corner kick.
44' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Aston Villa get a corner.
43' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
40' Dangerous play by Nelson Semedo (Wolves). Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
39' Flag goes up against Toti (Wolves) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
35' Looks like Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
34' Hee-Chan Hwang slides a brilliant pass into Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
29' A yellow card for a tackle by John McGinn (Aston Villa). Robert Jones doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
28' Craig Dawson (Wolves) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Robert Jones didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
26' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
23' Pedro Neto (Wolves) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
20' A cross from a corner kick by Wolves is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

20' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Wolves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
19' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
19' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
19' John McGinn (Aston Villa) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
16' Pedro Neto (Wolves) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
15' John McGinn (Aston Villa) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Robert Jones blows for a foul. Wolves are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
12' Joao Gomes (Wolves) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
11' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Wolves was in an offside position.

9' What a great effort! John McGinn (Aston Villa) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
8' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

8' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) picks up a cross inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the right side of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Jose Sa, who pulls off a stunning save! The linesman points to the corner flag, Aston Villa are going to take it.
6' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
5' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) takes a short corner kick.
4' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Lucas Digne (Aston Villa). Aston Villa force a corner. They send men into the box.
3' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Robert Jones has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
2' Pedro Neto (Wolves) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
1' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Wolves will kick the game off.
Robert Jones is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
